up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs and preferred names of all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725296', along with the document title. Join the docs table with compound_records on doc_id, and then with molecule_dictionary on molregno. Apply the filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725296'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS molecule_name, d.title AS document_title FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725296'}
